question: What supreme Eye of the two Śivas is honored as illumination and all-power?
premises: The Eye is of the nature of illumination
The Eye belongs to the two Śivas and is supreme
inference: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and all power.
uncertainties: The identity of the two Śivas is not explicitly specified.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all power.
